sessions.phase_label: Scope confirmation, source audit, and initial Android modernization
Localization, interface cleanup, and how-to guide redesign
Android completion review and demonstration preparation

requirements.title: Android OS and API Modernization
requirements.definition: Keep the Android application compatible with current Android platform standards by updating obsolete APIs, dependencies, and interface libraries.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Android platform and dependency modernization; permission compliance, packaging format, localization, and download size are independently actionable Requirements.

requirements.title: iOS OS and API Modernization
requirements.definition: Keep the iOS application compatible with current iOS standards, including replacing obsolete APIs such as UIWebView and supporting the agreed modern iOS baseline.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers iOS runtime and API compatibility; privacy manifests, signing, app thinning, localization, and visual cleanup have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Android Permission Compliance
requirements.definition: The Android application must not request unused sensitive permissions that can cause store-review or privacy problems.
requirements.boundary_note: Permission declarations can be corrected and reviewed independently from API modernization and package-size optimization.

requirements.title: iOS Privacy Manifest
requirements.definition: The iOS application must include the privacy manifest required for current Apple submission compliance.
requirements.boundary_note: The privacy manifest is a distinct required submission artifact and can be completed independently from code modernization and signing.

requirements.title: iOS App Signing Readiness
requirements.definition: The iOS application must have valid signing configuration and certificates suitable for current builds and store submission.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the executable signing configuration rather than credential transfer or other administrative access logistics.

requirements.title: Android Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Minimize the Android user-download footprint by removing redundant assets and applying appropriate binary-size optimizations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the measurable Android download-size outcome; App Bundle delivery is a distinct packaging artifact, while tutorial presentation is owned by how-to Requirements.

requirements.title: iOS Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Minimize the iOS user-download footprint by eliminating duplicate assets and applying suitable binary-size optimizations.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS size outcome can evolve and be verified independently from Android size and from the iOS App Thinning configuration.

requirements.title: Android App Bundle Packaging
requirements.definition: Produce the Android release using Android App Bundle packaging for optimized store distribution.
requirements.boundary_note: The required AAB artifact is independently testable even if the overall Android download-size target is not yet met.

requirements.title: iOS App Thinning
requirements.definition: Configure iOS distribution to use App Thinning or slicing so users receive an appropriately minimized build.
requirements.boundary_note: App Thinning is a concrete packaging behavior separate from the broader measurable iOS size outcome.

requirements.title: Android Full-App Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the full Android application, not only its store listing, across all 77 selected Google Play languages.
requirements.boundary_note: Language count and full-app coverage are attributes of one Android localization mechanism; FAQ content, social-link destinations, RTL layout, and optional language switching remain separate behaviors.

requirements.title: iOS Full-App Localization
requirements.definition: Localize the full iOS application, not only its store listing, across all supported App Store languages selected by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS localization lifecycle is separate from Android because the platforms have distinct string resources, language coverage, failures, and implementation paths.

requirements.title: Android Right-to-Left Layout Support
requirements.definition: Render the Android interface correctly for right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.
requirements.boundary_note: RTL layout behavior is independently testable from translated string coverage and from the corresponding iOS implementation.

requirements.title: iOS Right-to-Left Layout Support
requirements.definition: Render the iOS interface correctly for right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS RTL implementation can fail or be corrected independently from Android RTL support and general translation coverage.

requirements.title: FAQ Localization
requirements.definition: Represent the FAQ for both mobile platforms as localizable in-app string content.
requirements.boundary_note: FAQ content is independently requested and can be updated or localized without changing the wider application string catalog.

requirements.title: Localized Social-Media Links
requirements.definition: Use locale-appropriate social-media link destinations throughout the application.
requirements.boundary_note: Locale-specific link routing is distinct from translating visible labels and from the functionality of the how-to video link.

requirements.title: Localized Tutorial Image Presentation
requirements.definition: Present tutorial steps using reusable text-free backgrounds with translatable text overlays instead of separate text-embedded images for every language.
requirements.boundary_note: This image-and-overlay approach could be removed while guidance remained available through video, so it is separate from the how-to video Requirement and from general app localization.

requirements.title: How-to Video Guide
requirements.definition: Provide a working how-to-use guide through a single client-selected video available to users on both mobile platforms and streamed from YouTube.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the selected guide content, playback availability, and delivery source; the discarded multilingual tutorial-image approach and legacy Chinese Youku item remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Chinese Youku Video Integration
requirements.definition: Control whether the legacy Chinese video hosted through Youku remains part of the application.
requirements.boundary_note: The legacy Youku item received its own explicit removal and implementation claim, independent of the later universal YouTube how-to guide.

requirements.title: Ruler Magnifier Interaction
requirements.definition: Place the magnifier over the measurement ruler and move it along the ruler's intended path.
requirements.boundary_note: Magnifier positioning and motion are an independently testable interaction, separate from number alignment and title rendering.

requirements.title: Ruler Number Alignment
requirements.definition: Display the measurement ruler's numeric labels with correct visual alignment.
requirements.boundary_note: Numeric-label alignment has its own observable acceptance criterion and can be fixed independently from magnifier motion and title clipping.

requirements.title: Scoliometer Title Visibility
requirements.definition: Render the Scoliometer title text fully without clipping or truncation.
requirements.boundary_note: Title clipping is a distinct visual output that can fail independently from ruler alignment and magnifier behavior.

requirements.title: Skin Visual Cleanup
requirements.definition: Clean up and correctly render the application's alternate skin or reskin designs.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visual consistency of the selectable skins; iPad-specific layout and the measurement-screen controls have separate paths and acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: iPad Layout Cleanup
requirements.definition: Correct the iPad-specific interface layout so it renders cleanly rather than using the existing messy presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: The tablet layout is a distinct device context that can remain defective even when phone layouts and skin assets are corrected.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I carefully reviewed the source code for both Android and iOS. Below is what I identified and the improvements I would make.

**Present Condition**

The apps are functional, but both require fixes before they can be submitted to the stores today.

**Problems on iOS**

* The app relies on UIWebView, which Apple has removed, so Apple will reject it when submitted.
* It does not include the Privacy Manifest file required by Apple since May 2024.
* The localization setup does not work. Although there are 20 language folders, their translation files are absent, meaning the app always displays English regardless of the phone's selected language.
* Its signing certificates expired in 2015.
* Info.plist and the main ViewController.m are not present in the source you provided. I will need both files to work on iOS.

**Problems on Android**

* At 89 MB, the app is unnecessarily large. It does not use an Android App Bundle, code shrinking, or image optimization.
* It asks for the sensitive READ\_PHONE\_STATE permission without using it, which may cause Google Play review problems in certain regions.
* One removed sensor API is still in use, along with several other deprecated calls.
* Because of an HTTP/HTTPS compatibility problem, the Chinese video on Youku fails on modern Android.
* The libraries are extremely outdated and are 7+ versions behind the current releases.

**Improvements I Would Make**

1. Restore store-readiness:
* Replace UIWebView on iOS.
* Include the mandatory Privacy Manifest.
* Renew the certificates.
* Delete the unused dangerous Android permission.

2. Substantially decrease the app size:
* Move Android to the App Bundle format.
* Turn on code shrinking.
* Delete duplicate and unused images.
* On iOS alone, I identified approximately 10 MB of duplicated files.

3. Correct the localization implementation:
* Reconstruct the nonfunctional iOS translation system.
* Align the Android language files, since some languages are missing 26 strings.
* Rework the tutorial images so adding languages no longer requires new graphic design changes each time.

4. Modernize the old code:
* Update the dependencies.
* Substitute deprecated APIs.
* Bring the YouTube player implementation up to date.

5. Implement RTL support if required:
* Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian currently do not display correctly.

6. Meet current platform standards:
* Android 35, which Google will require soon.
* iOS 15+.

**Information Needed for Exact Timelines**

1. The iOS project seems incomplete because Info.plist and ViewController.m are missing. Can you provide the complete project?
2. Is the keystore password for the Android signing key available? The supplied files did not contain it.
3. Should the Chinese video on Youku remain, or may it be removed?
4. When adding languages, do you want the entire app localized or just translated store listing pages?

Once you confirm these points, I can prepare a detailed plan and estimated timeline.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I carefully reviewed the source code for both Android and iOS. Below is what I identified and the improvements I would make.

**Present Condition**

The apps are functional, but both require fixes before they can be submitted to the stores today.

**Problems on iOS**

* The app relies on UIWebView, which Apple has removed, so Apple will reject it when submitted.
* It does not include the Privacy Manifest file required by Apple since May 2024.
* The localization setup does not work. Although there are 20 language folders, their translation files are absent, meaning the app always displays English regardless of the phone's selected language.
* Its signing certificates expired in 2015.
* Info.plist and the main ViewController.m are not present in the source you provided. I will need both files to work on iOS.

**Problems on Android**

* At 89 MB, the app is unnecessarily large. It does not use an Android App Bundle, code shrinking, or image optimization.
* It asks for the sensitive READ\_PHONE\_STATE permission without using it, which may cause Google Play review problems in certain regions.
* One removed sensor API is still in use, along with several other deprecated calls.
* Because of an HTTP/HTTPS compatibility problem, the Chinese video on Youku fails on modern Android.
* The libraries are extremely outdated and are 7+ versions behind the current releases.

**Improvements I Would Make**

1. Restore store-readiness:
* Replace UIWebView on iOS.
* Include the mandatory Privacy Manifest.
* Renew the certificates.
* Delete the unused dangerous Android permission.

2. Substantially decrease the app size:
* Move Android to the App Bundle format.
* Turn on code shrinking.
* Delete duplicate and unused images.
* On iOS alone, I identified approximately 10 MB of duplicated files.

3. Correct the localization implementation:
* Reconstruct the nonfunctional iOS translation system.
* Align the Android language files, since some languages are missing 26 strings.
* Rework the tutorial images so adding languages no longer requires new graphic design changes each time.

4. Modernize the old code:
* Update the dependencies.
* Substitute deprecated APIs.
* Bring the YouTube player implementation up to date.

5. Implement RTL support if required:
* Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian currently do not display correctly.

6. Meet current platform standards:
* Android 35, which Google will require soon.
* iOS 15+.

**Information Needed for Exact Timelines**

1. The iOS project seems incomplete because Info.plist and ViewController.m are missing. Can you provide the complete project?
2. Is the keystore password for the Android signing key available? The supplied files did not contain it.
3. Should the Chinese video on Youku remain, or may it be removed?
4. When adding languages, do you want the entire app localized or just translated store listing pages?

Once you confirm these points, I can prepare a detailed plan and estimated timeline.
